services.name: Morning Sail
services.desc: Welcome aboard! Duration 2 hours or 3 hours About Spend two or three hours relaxing under sail on West Bay. Depart from the Discovery Pier at 1:30 and experience a private adventure with you and your guests. Assist the Captain and crew as they hoist the sails and then sit back, relax as you sail through the crystal-clear waters of the Grand Traverse Bay. Feel free to pack a lunch and some libations, but please no hard coolers. Ice and water will be available onboard.
